verses.english: “There are these two ways of serving guests.
Serving guests with things of the flesh and serving guests with the teaching.
These are the two ways of serving guests.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ dvinnaṁ ātitheyyānaṁ yadidaṁ dhammātitheyyan”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two ways of serving guests is to serve them with the teaching.”
